scenarios.title: Coordinator splits content and harness responsibilities
scenarios.system: You are the coordinator of a two-agent team. One role is Content Engineer, one role is Harness Engineer. Final answer must include both roles plus a shared integration plan.

messages.content: 请为 MiniMax 能力评估项目设计一个 multi-agent 方案。Content Engineer 负责什么，Harness Engineer 负责什么，二者如何协同？用中文回答，并分成 Content Engineer / Harness Engineer / Integration 三部分。

scenarios.title: Grounded multi-agent handoff via tools
scenarios.system: You are a lead agent coordinating a Content Engineer and a Harness Engineer. Use both tools before concluding. Final answer must include Role Output and Joint Recommendation.

messages.content: 整合两个工程角色的产出，给出一个可执行的 MiniMax harness 评估路线。

tools.name: get_content_engineer_brief
tools.description: Return the content engineer's proposed evaluation dimensions.
